spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Three
 Days
 and
 Two Deaths

---


**
¶1.
** Know
, beloved
,
 that there exist three great states
 of spiritual progression in
 all;
 and also two great and bitter devast
ations of
 the spirit
.

---


**¶4.** The
 first state
 is the celestial will itself
, the
 original
 human
 of
 love
 as
 created
 by
 the Divine.
 From the time when this
 celest
ial will descended into the
 abyss of falsity and was
 overwhelmed by it —
 and Divine
 Truth proce
eding from the Lord was sent forth,
 which
 went down
 and raised
 it
 up.
 After the celestial will had been
 lifted
 from
 fals
ity, Divine
 Love and Divine Wisdom brought all
 things into order:
 the interior
 mind
 and the exterior mind
,
 the heav
enly
 and the natural
.

---

**¶5
.** Furthermore, the Divine
 Proceeding in its mediating form
 came and
 dwelt within the doctrine of illumination
. He made
 visible
 the form of Divine Good and Truth,
 and he
 separated
 genuine
 wisdom from fals
ity throughout all
 things
. He governed
 from the inmost celestial states.
 Until
 the time
 when the old
 spiritual
 dispensation would be dissolved, all its
 external
 forms consumed
, the
 fire
 of Divine Love released in
 judgment
, and the fully regenerated human form
 asc
ended into
 whol
eness. These three works of redemption
 were begun in that
 first state, when the celestial will
 was
 sent
 forth
 with its five faculties of spiritual perception
.

*
Note
:* "
The five
 sons
"
 corresponds
 to the five interior
 s
enses of
 the
 celest
ial will — the fac
ulties through
 which the original
 human
 perceived
,
 received
, and responded
 to Divine infl
ux. They
 answer
 to what
 Swedenborg calls the s
enses of the internal
 man
.

---

**¶6
.** In
 contrast, the first devastation is the
 falsity and evil that infiltrated and
 min
gled with the five fac
ulties of perception
 belonging to the celest
ial will —
 the dark
ening of every
 avenue
 through
 which the Divine
 had
 been received
.

---

**¶7
.** The second state is the
 time when the celestial principles of wisdom
, having prevailed through the
 ord
eal of spiritual combat, enter into states
 of governance within
 the new dispens
ation, and dwell in the renewed
 natural mind. And
 they reign
 in this
 new spiritual
 order
 until
 Divine
 Love unve
ils its inmost form above
 them.

---

**¶
8.** The measure
 of the dwelling
 in the new dispens
ation corresponds to
 the measure of the first state spent in
 affliction and temptation.
 Precisely
 as
 long
 as the struggle
 end
ured, so
 long do
 they reign
 and
 rejoice within
 the new state
.
 The
 b
lessedness answers
 to the suffering
 in
 exact
 proportion.


---

**¶9.
** The great third state is when Divine
 Love unveils over
 them its inmost form, and raises
 them up from
 all
 remaining
 limitation
,
 and receives them into the hidden interior of
 the Divine itself —
 the
 secret treasury of the Lord
's
 own life
. He pours upon
 them celestial delight and the in
most perception of good, which takes
 away every
 affl
iction they have endured through their understanding
. Fullness and eternal joy!
 When his grace has
 s
ated them, he gives to them his
 very essence
,
 and they are made entirely
 new within it
.

*
Note:* "Am
brosia and
 sweet perfume" —
 celestial delight and the perception of
 good
. The perf
ume that
 removes
 affl
iction seen
 "
with their eyes" is the in
most good that
 he
als every
 wound
 infl
icted through
 the understanding of
 truth
 during
 states
 of tem
ptation.

---

**
¶10.** Also
, he summons them once more into
 perfect
 peace and interior
 silence, and brings
 their
 regenerated human form to completion
 in the same measure as the original celest
ial states from
 before
 the fall. And
 he establ
ishes each faculty within
 its own proper
 state, in its own dwelling. They
 dwell in the new dispensation,
 each
 within
 the
 state
 that
 belongs to it
.

---

**¶11
.** Now
, when they dwell in their proper
 states, they become immeasurably
 enriched, beyond all succession
, beyond
 time
. From then on they do not rec
kon progression
 among themselves, nor the number of states
, nor the intervals
,
 generation
 after generation, forever. Divine Love is
 no longer hidden from them,
 from
 this time on. Rather, he has
 accomplished his full unve
iling to them —
 being revealed
 to them eternally,
 without
 conce
alment.

*
Note:* This
 is the state
 Swedenborg describes
 as the celest
ial itself
 — where
 the Divine is
 perceived
 not
 through
 tru
ths as
 a
 medium
, but immediately
 through
 love
.
 Time
 ce
ases because
 there
 is no longer
 any
 progression
 through
 states of
 truth
 toward
 good
;
 the soul
 r
ests in good
 itself.
 "
He
 will
 not be hidden"
 — the
 Lord
 is
 perceived
 face
 to face, as
 He
 is.


---

**¶12.
** These are the three great states of
 spiritual
 progression,
 which the Divine Love of the Lord has
 numbered
 and
 ordered in the r
eckoning of redemption.

---


**¶14.** The
 first devastation extends from the time when
 wisdom fell into falsity,
 and was mixed in
 with the ruling evils of the unre
generate mind —
 until the time when wisdom is purified
 and wholly
 separated from falsity through the consuming
 fire of Divine Love in final judgment.
 Whatever
 of
 good
 and
 truth remains behind,
 even
 from
 that
 long
 capt
ivity, contributes to and completes
 the fully regenerated human form.


*
Note:* "The Last
 Statue" — the ultimate
 human form,
 the
 *
Max
imus Homo
*, recon
stituted from
 all
 the wisdom
 and good that was
 held
 capt
ive within fals
ity. Every
 fragment
 recovered
 from the struggle
 adds
 to the final st
ature of
 the regenerated whole
.

---

**¶15
.** Now
, the second devastation is that in
 which the interiors of those who confirmed
 themselves in evil perish utt
erly.
 They are stripped of the radiance of
 divine
 truth that had
 illuminated
 their
 natural mind.
 They are also
 sev
ered from the spiritual atmosphere through
 which they had
 received the influx of life;
 and
 they are deprived of the living
 will,
 the
 anim
ating good
 that had
 sustained
 them while
 in
 the world. They are separated
 and
 swept away from the regener
ated human form — cut
 off from every
 communion
 with it
 —
 and bound within
 their
 own ev
ils
.
 Perverted affection becomes the
 very
 substance
 of their torment and anguish
,
 turning
 in
ward upon
 itself
 without
 end
.

*Note:* "The
 female will
 become
 their
 torture"
 res
ists
 easy
 translation. My
 best
 reading:
 the
 aff
ect
ional
 faculty
 — the will
 as
 recipient
 of love
 — when
 wholly
 perv
erted,
 becomes the instrument
 of self
-tor
ment. What
 was
 made
 to receive
 celest
ial love
 now
 receives
 only
 the fire
 of self
-love turned
 upon
 itself.
 This
 is the spiritual
 meaning
 of hell
 as
 intr
insic,
 not imposed
.


---

**¶16.
** These are the two devastations.
 The first devastation is temporal:
 it
 end
ures through
 all
 the
 states of combat
 and pur
ification, and
 it
 ends
.
 The second devastation is eternal: it
 is the state
 in
 which the will
 is so
 confirmed
 in evil that no
 further
 state
 of
 regener
ation is possible.
 *
It is the second death.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: that there exist three great mighty days in all; and also two great and bitter deaths.

The first day is our father, the Man. From the time when the First Man went down to the abyss of darkness and drowned in it; and the Living Spirit was sent, who went and bore him up. After the Man had ascended, the Father of Life and the Great Spirit set things in order, and the worlds above and below.

Furthermore, the glorious Ambassador came and dwelt in the ship of the day. He displayed his glorious image, and he purified the light out of all things. He walked in the heights of the heavens. Till the time when the world will be dissolved, all things destroyed, the great fire released, and the Last Statue ascends. These three deeds were begun on this first day, when they sent the First Man with his five sons.
In contrast, [the first death] is the Darkness that mixed with the five sons of the First Man.

The second day is the time when the fathers of light, who were victorious in the struggle, will sit on their thrones in the new aeon and dwell on the new earth. And they reign in the new aeon till the Father unveils his image above them.
The length of the sojourn in the new aeon equals the measure of the first day spent in affliction. They will reign like this and rejoice in the new aeon.

The great third day [is the time] when the Father will unveil over them his image [in the fullness of his light] [and the splendour of his glory;] and he raises them up [above every deficiency,] and he receives them into his hidden treasury [of life,] and he gives [to each] his soul. He can pour out upon them [the fullness of] his ambrosia and his sweet perfume, which takes away all affliction that they have seen with their eyes. [It is] fullness and a joy eternal! When his grace would sate them, he gives to them his [garments of light,] and they are made anew in them.

Also, he can summon them once more in peace and silence, and perfect their stature in same measure as his first aeons. And he sets each power in its aeon, in its dwelling-place. They will dwell in the new aeon in their aeons!

Now, when they dwell in their aeons, they will become rich beyond measure, for ever, beyond time. From then on they will not count that season amongst them; nor the number of the days, nor the hours, generation after generation, for ever and ever. The Father will not be hidden from them, from this time on. Rather, he has accomplished (his) unveiling to them [in its completeness,] he being revealed to them for ever.
These are the three great days, [which the Father of Greatness has numbered and set in order in the reckoning of all things].

The first death is from the time when the light fell to the Darkness, and was mixed in with the rulers of darkness; until the time when the light will become pure, and be separated from the darkness in that great fire. The remainder left behind there can build and add to that Last Statue.
These are the two deaths. The first death is temporal; [but] the second death is eternal. It is the sec[ond deat]h!

Now, the second death is the death in which the souls of sinful men shall die; when [they will] be stripped of the shining light that illuminates the world. And also they are separated from the living air, from which they receive [living] breath; and they are deprived of this living soul, which [ ... ] in the world; and they are separated and swept away from this Last Statue [ ... ... ] and bound on [ ... ... ] the female will become [ ... ] their torture and their affliction;
